question: How do Defenseply PVC and WPC boards compare to conventional marine plywood?
answer: Unlike traditional marine plywood which relies on wood veneers bound with resins, Defenseply boards are engineered cellular polymer composites. They are 100% waterproof, totally immune to termite and borer infestation, will never delaminate or swell when submerged in water, and are completely free from toxic formaldehyde emissions.

question: Can Defenseply boards be worked using standard carpentry tools and CNC machinery?
answer: Yes. Defenseply boards can be cut, drilled, routed, milled, and nailed using standard woodworking tools and carbide-tipped blades. They excel on CNC routing machines with zero chipping or fuzzy edges, making them the preferred substrate for intricate architectural jali work, fluted panels, and curved profiles.

question: What paints, laminates, and surface finishes can be applied to Defenseply surfaces?
answer: Defenseply features an ultra-smooth, high-density calibrated surface. It is directly compatible with PU paints, duco finishes, UV digital printing, PVC membrane pressing, acrylic sheets, and high-pressure laminates (HPL). We also manufacture pre-finished PVC Colour Boards that require no painting whatsoever.

question: What thicknesses, sheet sizes, and custom densities do you manufacture?
answer: Our standard sheet dimension is 8 ft x 4 ft (2440 mm x 1220 mm), available in thicknesses ranging from 6mm up to 30mm. For large-scale architectural, institutional, or export orders, our Kuttippuram plant can produce custom sheet lengths, tailored densities (0.45 g/cm³ to 0.70 g/cm³), and specialized 3-layer co-extruded structures.

question: Are Defenseply boards fire-retardant and certified for commercial use?
answer: Yes. Defenseply products feature Class 1 fire retardancy with self-extinguishing properties (they do not propagate flame and self-extinguish when the flame source is removed). They are non-toxic, lead-free (RoHS compliant), and contribute valuable LEED green building points for eco-conscious projects.
